source_record.title: Hyperparameter Scaling Laws Across MoE Sparsity
source_record.problem: 总参数或激活参数相同的 MoE 仍可能需要不同的学习率和 batch；稀疏度变化使小实验超参数迁移失效。
source_record.insight: 将专家激活比例 A 作为独立预测变量，分别以 (C,A) 和 (D,A) 拟合峰值学习率与全局 token batch；留组预测并在预先冻结的超稀疏配置上检验。
source_record.limitation: 单一骨干、语料、Muon、路由与调度；一个联合外推目标；激活参数量未超出拟合范围；全网格多种子覆盖不足；候选函数区间重叠；不构成下游能力定律。
source_record.reading_depth: 核验 arXiv 作者和完整版本历史；重点阅读 v1 HTML 摘要、§1–4.4、§6–7，查阅 §5；未审计附录 A–C、未视觉复核图像、未运行实验。

decisions.proposed_text_zh:
选择稀疏架构也会改变优化配方。[Tian et al.，2026 年 9 月 8 日](https://arxiv.org/html/2609.08690v1)将专家激活比例 $A=E_{\mathrm{act}}/E_{\mathrm{tot}}$ 加入超参数预测；它不同于激活参数与总参数的比值。作者拟合 $\eta^*=k_\eta C^{\gamma_\eta}A^{\delta_\eta}$ 和 $B^*=k_BD^{\gamma_B}A^{\delta_B}$，其中 $\eta$ 是峰值学习率，$B$ 是每次更新的全局 token 数，$D$ 是训练 token 数，$C=MD$ 是解析计算的非嵌入 FLOPs。在其设置内，稀疏度提高对应固定 $C$ 下更低的学习率，以及固定 $D$ 下更大的 batch。

研究报告了 1,800 次运行、约 10M–324M 激活参数，并按激活比例或模型规模留组验证。对总参数 12B、激活参数 324M、$A=1/64$、训练 159B token 的模型，预先冻结的预测接近所观察到的最优点。激活规模仍位于拟合范围边缘：这是稀疏度、token 和计算量的一次联合外推，而非沿每个轴分别验证。实验共享混合注意力骨干、Muon 优化器、语料和 warmup–stable–decay 调度。候选函数形式的区间重叠且随机种子覆盖有限，因此仍有不确定性；这些系数不能确立普适配方或下游能力定律。
decisions.proposed_text_en:
Choosing a sparse architecture also changes the optimization recipe. [Tian et al., 8 September 2026](https://arxiv.org/html/2609.08690v1) add the expert activation ratio $A=E_{\mathrm{act}}/E_{\mathrm{tot}}$ to hyperparameter prediction; this differs from the active-to-total parameter ratio. They fit $\eta^*=k_\eta C^{\gamma_\eta}A^{\delta_\eta}$ and $B^*=k_BD^{\gamma_B}A^{\delta_B}$, where $\eta$ is peak learning rate, $B$ global tokens per update, $D$ training tokens, and $C=MD$ analytically computed non-embedding FLOPs. Within their setting, greater sparsity favors a lower learning rate at fixed $C$ and a larger batch at fixed $D$.

The study reports 1,800 runs, approximately 10M–324M activated parameters, and grouped validation holding out activation ratios or model scales. A frozen prediction approaches the observed optimum for a 12B-total/324M-activated model with $A=1/64$, trained on 159B tokens. Activated size remains at the fitted range's boundary: this is one joint extrapolation in sparsity, tokens, and compute, not independent validation along every axis. The experiments share a hybrid attention backbone, Muon optimizer, corpus, and warmup–stable–decay schedule. Overlapping intervals across candidate functional forms and limited seed coverage leave uncertainty; these coefficients do not establish a universal recipe or downstream-capability law.

cross_review.subsection: From Ranking Transfer to Joint Prediction / 从排序迁移到联合预测
cross_review.read_this_week: Targeted §2 equations, §3.4, §4 Tables 1–2, §5, §6 run-count/cosine discussion, §8 limitations.
cross_review.result: No substantive mismatch identified between source and new bilingual paragraphs; Chinese and English convey the same conditions.
verified: Additive mixture dependence is confined to the bias term; joint form makes A and B mixture-dependent while retaining constant exponents.
LLM fitting sizes 412M–1.4B and evaluation sizes 3B/7B match Table 1.
Table 2 validation MRE: Wikipedia 4.45% to 2.09%; GitHub 1.17% to 2.51%.
Six/eight-domain run-count experiments fix model size; not arbitrary cross-scale search.
The optimized 7B mixture runs use cosine scheduling and cannot directly validate original constant-schedule extrapolation.
cross_review.optional_refinement: The actual optimized 7B LLM mixture selection uses the additive law because it has lower aggregate MRE in that experiment. Current prose already avoids universal joint-law superiority, so this is optional context rather than an error.
